items.title: This Week in Stupid: November 14 edition
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
As another stupid week comes to a close here in America, let’s look back at the dumbest fucking shit that happened.

“A smart man washes his hands after he urinates. A wise man doesn’t urinate on his hands.”

Um, Senator Kennedy? I have a question.

I really wish more of his colleagues had gone to Oxford with him, because I’m pretty sure the entire MAGAverse has been pissing on its own hands for years.

Tuesday: a septum is a terrible thing to waste

“…was sentenced at Southwork Crown Court to ten years and six months in prison. One rape conviction. Three sexual assault convictions. He was convicted by the way, with no forensic evidence. No DNA. No police report from the time. Now, decades old, from allegations back from 1999.”

Now there’s a good look. Defending the convicted rapist Russell Brand while seemingly having half the gross national product of Bolivia up one’s nostrils.

Holy shit, can Don Jr. even feel his face right now? It doesn’t look like it.

Do you know why Hunter Biden was able to clean himself up? Because he wanted to, and because he had a loving family willing to get him the help he needed.

Cokey’s family is apparently too busy pissing on their own hands to help him deal with his shit.

Wednesday: a sense of decency is a terrible thing to waste

We can’t see Rick Santorum’s hands in the clip below, but I’ll wager good money that he was pissing all over them while recording it.

“Face it, these are temporal issues. Yes, they matter. Of course they matter. You’re upset because prices are high. And I don’t think the president has done a particularly good job of explain why the war in Iran was so essential to fight radical Islam. But the reality is, you know, everybody has to look at what the bigger issues are in the country. And I understand paying a dollar more our two or three dollars more for diesel fuel has an impact on your family. But you have a responsibility to look beyond just comply what affects your pocketbook. And there may be a reason that you have to suffer financially for a higher good.”

Can these idiots get any more tone-deaf?

This is why your party got slaughtered at the polls, Rick. Voters won’t want to be lectured on how it’s their patriotic duty to shut the fuck up about gas prices.

You know what? I hope the GOP keeps right on repeating this noxious nonsense, all the way to the 2028 elections. I hope they continue to be as repellent as possible. Maybe we can end up with zero elected Republicans. You may say I’m a dreamer, but I’m not the only one.

Hey, did Rick Santorum and that dog he was seeing ever get married? I hope they’re very happy together.

No, seriously, did he? For some reason, Senator Mushmouth really wants to know.

Thursday: a mind is a terrible thing to have never had in the first place

“Unfortunately, we were all wrong, races can be baught.”

Oh my god, can I just say that I AM GOING TO MISS THIS WOMAN. She has been a boon to This Week In Stupid. She’s a one-woman perpetual motion dumbfuck-factory. By voting her out of office and removing her from the public eye, the people of Colorado’s fourth district have really made my job that much harder.

And, I hope that wherever Lauren Boebert ends up next, she keeps washing her hands. For many reasons.

Friday: the further adventures of Some Fucking Idiot™

On Friday, some fucking idiot was missing in action. He had no public appearances, and —shockingly! — only posted three times to his crappy app. But not to worry, his ace team of cabinet-level hand-pissers were way too happy to step into the breach.

You’ll never fucking guess what happened on Friday.

Oh, and Marky Two-Names, the former failed plumber’s assistant now ostensibly in charge of homeland security was on the case, too. His main concern was that everybody called the plagiarism robot by its proper name.

So, what was the fucking idiot doing while all this was going on? Did he go on TV to reassure a nervous nation? Did he say anything at all?

All this, while every plane in the nation was stuck on the ground, leaving ONE AND A HALF MILLION air travelers stranded.

And because the fucking idiot was missing in action, holed up god knows where in the White House with his beloved Diaper Nurse, not one reporter had the opportunity to stand up and ask, ‘what the fuck is wrong with you?’

How fucking idiotic is that?

And now, let’s put a close to This Week in Stupid and reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia.

This photo has ‘June 15, 1996’ written on the back of it. I have no idea where it was taken.

Here we are at some family event in the 1990s. that’s my uncle Alan and aunt Ellen, and there’s Katie in the background, seated at a table. Ms Spouse sure had style, didn’t she?

Have a non-stupid Saturday, everyone.

items.title: Let’s all point and laugh at the panicking imbecile in the Oval Bordello
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Pour one out for Preznit Fuckwit. He’s going through some things right now.

No, strike that — pour them out for Preznit Fuckwit. He’s going through right now. Donny knows that come January, once the Democratic majorities are sworn in, his life is going to — and he’s having a rather hard time coping.

The rabid family of coked-up raccoons that live inside Dear Leader’s fat, waterlogged skull were seriously working overtime yesterday morning, chewing through the wires. Donny was wide awake and panic-posting around 5am, shitting out increasingly-deranged lunacy onto his crappy app. Every grudge and grievance got a good airing out.

The Democrat Party, lead by one of the most Corrupt and anti-American groups of political leaders and hacks in the history of our Country, and even the World, is doing everything in their power to get away from MASSIVE BLUE STATE CORRUPTION by saying, over and over again, that the Trump Administration is corrupt. It is a sound bite that they viciously use, over and over again, in order to nullify the TREMENDOUS & UNPRECEDENTED theft that has taken place in our Blue States - Minnesota, California, and others, all over the U.S.A. I, perhaps foolishly because the Fake News refuses to write about it, including in my First Term, don’t even take a Salary, worth Millions of Dollars. I am the only President to have done so! In any event, THE DEMOCRATS ARE CORRUPT AND EVIL, and I am the exact opposite! Fight hard, Republicans, or you won’t have a Country left! President DONALD J. TRUMP

Corrupty McCorruptionface says what?

Next year, Democrats are going to have a field day, looking into Dear Leader’s malfeasance. Just off the top of my head, there’s the selling of pardons, the insider trading, the crypto scams, the market manipulation, and the doling out of massive defense contracts to his felonious failsons.

And the only thing Donny can say in his own defense is ‘I know you are, but what am I?’

Q: Trump said Liz Cheney should go to jail and Adam Schiff should go to prison, he declared Barack Obama of treason. What legal standard are you applying to distinguish what they say and what the president says?

BLANCHE: There can come a point when a criticism becomes a threat and when a threat becomes something criminal.

Holy shit, Blanche really is the tiny mobster from the Bugs Bunny cartoons. Look at him. All he needs is the clownishly oversized hat.

Muggsy Blanche is so fucktacularly terrible at being an enforcer. There’s nothing whatsoever that’s intimidating about him. And he can only dance around the reporter’s question and avoid answering it, because as much as Donny wishes it were true, criticism of Dear Leader is not yet a hate crime in the US.

Never bring a Muggsy to a Constitution fight. He’s out of his depth. Just listen to Jamie Raskin serve him up a big slice of Fuck You Pie.

“The government cannot intimidate people because they exercise their First Amendment rights in a way that government officials don’t like. That’s ridiculous. Somebody should tell Todd Blanche and his team to get a Supreme Court decision called Steffel v. Thompson, which says it’s legally actionable to bring an injunction action against the government if the government is trying to scare you out of exercising your First Amendment rights and your Constitutional rights.

In our case, it’s not just that these members were exercising their Constitutional rights; they were exercising their constitutional duties. We have a duty, as the Article I preeminent branch of government, to conduct oversight operations of the entire government, as well as the economy and other things happening in society.”

Jaime, stop it. He’s already dead.

Here’s the thing that Donny and his few remaining loyalists haven’t yet figured out: nobody is afraid of him any more. He’s the lamest of ducks. The other day, when he started whining about the election results, it was Megyn Kelly — Little Miss Fear of a Black Santa herself — who told Donny to zip it.

Quack fucking quack, Dear Leader. Enjoy your ever-increasing irrelevance.

I’m actually referring to your 30,000 stock trades (more than all Members of Congress combined), your Qatari-gifted luxury jet, your crypto scams, your Truth Social pay to play scheme, your billionaire-funded ballroom, your insurrectionist slush fund, and your pardons for big donors—just to name a few.

Will the Seditious Six ever be prosecuted? What they did was a great violation to our Country and its Constitution! President DONALD J. TRUMP

The Seditious Six? Donny is still whining about the six Congresspeople who put out that video reminding U.S. service members they have a duty to refuse illegal orders? That’s one of many bugs that are up Donny ass on this particular morning?

I have asked Vice President Vance to focus his complete and total attention on the Massive Corruption and Crime taking place in Democrat run Cities and States throughout the U.S. The Blue States, such as Minnesota, California, Illinois, and many more, are all poorly run, corrupt disasters.

Wait, seriously? Couchfuck McGee is now Donny’s corruption czar?

I’m loving this idea. I would pay good money to watch Couchfuck show up at the Minnesota State Capitol and go ‘so, how long have you been corrupt? HA HA, THAT’S GREAT.’

Here we go again! With the perceived loss by the Republicans in the Midterms - I WAS NOT ON THE BALLOT- the INVASION of our Country is taking place again. Huge CARAVANS are forming and beginning their illegal march through Mexico. Many of the people in these Caravans are those that various countries don’t want - “Send them to America,” they say - But they will not be accepted! MEXICO MUST STOP THEM, NOW, and if they do not do so, the Tariffs on Mexico will be IMMEDIATELY DOUBLED. MEXICO, THE GOVERNOR OF TEXAS, THE VERY LIBERAL NEW GOVERNOR OF TEXAS, OUR GREAT BORDER PATROL, & ICE, HAVE BEEN SO INFORMED. There will be no leniency! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

Holy shit, he’s off his rocker. This is what happens when you live in a fact-free bubble and get all your information from Nosferatu McGoebbels and the Diaper Nurse.

What ‘perceived’ loss in the midterms? What is Donny yammering about? There was nothing ‘perceived’ about the ass-whupping that Donny’s party got. And ? Really? No, Donny, no. You’re supposed to fearmonger about imaginary caravans the election, after.

Dear Leader is bugfuck nuts, and he’s just getting worse. All this batshittery is just from the of the investigations that won’t ramp up until next year. What’s going to happen then? He’s going to completely lose his fucking mind, and god knows what he’s dumbfuckery he’s going to get up to. He’ll probably try to nuke the Capitol building.

This shit is unsustainable.

25th Amendment, let’s go. I’ll take my chances with the couch fucker.

In this election, Americans called on us to unrig an economy rigged against working people & fueled by political corruption.

To deliver, we need new leadership. This isn’t about any one person – it’s about answering that call.

That’s why I’m running for Senate Majority Leader.

We need this. It’s time for the Democratic leadership to be younger and more progressive.

Yes, I know. Senator Van Hollen is 67 years old. That’s still younger than Chuck Schumer, who’s 75.

And he’s definitely more progressive.

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

A friend texted this photo to me last night. I’d never seen it before. It’s Ms Spouse and her bestie Kathy down at our lake on November 12, 2022.

Okay, that’s put me in the mood for more Kathy and Claudia pics, so here you go.

Have a great Friday, everyone.

items.title: Republicans hate our veterans — and no one hates them more than Preznit Fuckwit
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Yesterday was Veterans Day, and we heard a lot of pungent mouth-farting from the Usual Republican Suspects about how much they and our nation’s veterans.

There they were, tweeting out the same old boilerplate platitudes about and .

It’s all bullshit. The GOP our veterans.

As always, watch what they do, not what they say.

Veterans are useful props whenever some fuckface wingnut needs to burnish their patriot cred, but when it comes time to supporting our veterans — say, by helping them when they’re in need — it’s a completely different story.

Need proof? Let’s go to the video tape, from July 29, 2022:

Here we have a bunch of Republican Senators fist-bumping. Why? Because they just blocked a billthat would have expanded healthcare coverage for military veterans exposed to toxic burn pits during their service.

Who the fuck that? Put down your fists, and at least have the decency to slink away in silence, embarrassed over your ghoulish treachery.

Awesome job, you evil soulless hypocrites — because nothing says ‘we support our heroes’ so much as ‘just fucking die.’

Now let’s fast forward to April 2025, when the Space Nazi’s merry band of unfuckable DOGE incels showed up at the Department of Veterans Affairs and said, ‘good news, everyone — you’re all fired.’ They then took a wrecking ball to the place.

Listen up, shitwits: you send a person into a war zone and tell them to fight for their country, and when they come back injured and permanently disabled, you fucking well take care of them — forever.

It’s basic human decency.

The freedoms we enjoy as Americans came at a cost. Generations answered the call to serve, putting their lives on the line to defend our country and way of life. This Veterans Day, join me in honoring and thanking those who served. We owe them a debt we can never repay.

Steve, with all due respect, fuck off.

You voted against the VA Employee Fairness Act, the Veteran Service Recognition Act, the PACT Act (twice), the Equal Access to Contraception for Veterans Act, and the Ensuring Veterans Smooth Transition Act.

For a guy who claims to honor those who made sacrifices, you have a fucked-up way of showing it.

“Today we salute the brave men and women who wore our nation’s uniform and defended the homeland. Their sacrifice deserves our gratitude, our respect, and our unwavering support. Never forget those who fought for our freedom. God bless our veterans and the United States of America!”

Sit down and shut up, you vapid bobblehead.

In your first term in Congress, you made 15 anti-veteran votes. Last year, you voted to cut funding for the 49,000 veterans in your district by supporting a bill that guts their health care.

How delicious is it that this complete waste of space was just denied reelection by an actual veteran, the retired Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher?

, Handy. Enjoy fading back into well-deserved obscurity.

“God bless our veterans from Ohio and across the country for their service and sacrifice this Veterans Day.”

By the way, Jimmy Jords can barely be bothered to commemorate the day. He just shits out the same bare minimum every year. Here’s his post from 2025.

“Happy Veterans Day! God Bless all who served. American heroes!”

Shove it, Jimmy. you voted against the PACT Act, the Food Security for All Veterans Act, the Veteran Service Recognition Act and the VA Employee Fairness Act.

Don’t even get me started on five-time draft-dodging diaperload.

I’d love to show you the heartfelt Veterans Day message that Donny posted to his crappy app, but I couldn’t find one. Nothing. Not even a concept of a sketch of one.He couldn’t even be bothered to pretend to give a shit.

Yesterday, Preznit Fuckwit traveled to Arlington National Cemetery and laid a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier Who Didn’t Have A Rich Father To Get Him Out Of War By Paying A Quack Doctor To Gin Up A Bullshit Note About Imaginary Bone Spurs.

“Soon we’re going to dedicate a magnificent triumphant arch to our veterans.”

Oh, so now we’re supposed to pretend Lord Shitticus is putting up his ginormous arch for ? Oh, please. The fucking abomination is going to plunge the gravesites at Arlington National Cemetery into permanent shadow.

Before we move on, it must be noted that what remains of Dear Leader’s pudding-brain has become a neurological superfund toxic cleanup site.

“Green Beret Ryan Hendrickson was leading his team through a— Taliban-held village in Afghanistan at— 3 in the morning when he was— stepped on by— enemy? I mean, he was the enemy, the enemy was all over. He made the mistake. A mistake that— people understood when they were in the battles, jungles.”

Holy shit. What the fuck was that?

Donny completely loses the thread of what he’s reading off the teleprompter, and just starts winging it. Afghanistan doesn’t have any jungles (I checked with the plagiarism robot, just to make sure), but there are jungles in every war movie Donny’s ever seen on TV, so there you go. He can no longer tell fact from the dim, flickering images playing inside his fat, waterlogged head.

What an utter fucking embarrassment.

Let’s take a look at Donny’s own long history of quote-unquote , because — spoiler alert — .

We can start with that lovely incident in 2024 when private citizen (and convicted felon) Donny trespassed his way into Arlington National Cemetery to do a disgraceful thumb’s-up campaign photo-op while trampling over the graves of fallen heroes — and grinning like an asshole the whole time.

Let’s also not forget that in November 2018, as world leaders gathered at a cemetery in France to honor the memory of US soldiers killed while fighting in World War One, Donny blew the whole thing off — because it was drizzling lightly, and he didn’t want that weird tangle of piss-colored bullshit on top of his head to get wet. Instead, he spent the day rage-tweeting from his hotel room. Good times, bro, good times.

What kind of overgrown grievance-toddler gets mad at a fucking boat?

Now I want to repost something I wrote on September 24, 2023 — because of all the shitty episodes regarding Little Donny Fuckface’s callous treatment of our veterans, this one just might be the rock-bottom worst:

At his welcome ceremony at Joint Base Myer–Henderson Hall, across the Potomac River from the capital, Milley gained an early, and disturbing, insight into Trump’s attitude toward soldiers. Milley had chosen a severely wounded Army captain, Luis Avila, to sing “God Bless America.” Avila, who had completed five combat tours, had lost a leg in an IED attack in Afghanistan and had suffered two heart attacks, two strokes, and brain damage as a result of his injuries. To Milley, and to four-star generals across the Army, Avila and his wife, Claudia, represented the heroism, sacrifice, and dignity of wounded soldiers.

It had rained that day, and the ground was soft; at one point Avila’s wheelchair threatened to topple over. Milley’s wife, Holly­anne, ran to help Avila, as did Vice President Mike Pence. After Avila’s performance, Trump walked over to congratulate him, but then said to Milley, within earshot of several witnesses, “Why do you bring people like that here? No one wants to see that, the wounded.”Never let Avila appear in public again, Trump told Milley. (Recently, Milley invited Avila to sing at his retirement ceremony.)

what a cold-hearted dick.

“why do you bring people like that here? no one wants to see that, the wounded.”

imagine you’re a severely wounded soldier. after five combat tours, sacrificing yourself for your country — you find yourself in a military hospital, minus one leg, your life permanently altered. you live though months of hell — bedridden, undergoing multiple operations and grueling physical therapy — and when finally you’re discharged, you’re confined to a wheelchair for the rest of your life.

and what does the President of the United States — your Commander in Chief — say about you?

“no one wants to see that, the wounded.”

fuck you, Donald Trump. you piece of shit.

Donny, Handy Oakley, Scalise, the whole worthless lot of them — the next time any of these grandstanding performative peacocks starts going on and on about how much they love the shit out of our veterans, remember: watch what they do, not what they say.

But oh you lucky duckies, I saved the most egregious behavior for last.

“Happy Veterans Day — to our best Americans. The Hegseth’s are honored to celebrate our veterans this morning at Arlington with @POTUS, @VP & @SecVetAffairs. Thank God for our warriors, past and present.”

Oh, the really? The Hegseths (no apostrophe, brainiac) are ‘honored to celebrate our veterans’?

These fuckfaces start laughing it up, in front one of our nation’s most solemn monuments — to the point where the guard on duty literally SCREAMS at them that ‘ALL VISITORS WILL MAINTAIN AN ATMOSPHERE OF SILENCE AND PAY RESPECT AT ALL TIMES!”

That’s right, they take this shit seriously at the Tomb. They don’t care if you’re the piss-drunk Secretary of Whatever You’re Calling Yourself This Week. You will keep your fucking mouth shut at all times. This isn’t some open mike. Zip it and keep it zipped.

Go laugh it up in front of the Epstein Dance Hall™, if you must.

Oh my god, it’s every bit as fucktacularly bad as we suspected it would be.

Accountability cannot come soon enough.

We really need a little Daily Claudia right about now, don’t we?

Here’s a triptych from the Newburgh NY restaurant Blu Pointe on September 18, 2025.

Have a great Thursday, everyone.

items.title: House Republicans reveal their 2027 plan: to be unserious, obstructionist shitwits
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Last week’s midterm elections should have been the perfect teachable moment for Republicans. Had they bothered to listen to what We the People were saying, they would have very clearly heard, ‘we’re tired of this shit. Clean up your fucking act, or get used to permanent irrelevance.’

But, of course, Republicans don’t know how to listen — . They proved it yesterday by choosing as their House Leader the huge, steaming pantload, Jim Jordan.

What even is a Jim Jordan? We’ve all seen him strutting around like some fucked-up barnyard banty rooster, shouty, half-dressed, pointing his finger while he excitedly squawks about who the fuck even knows or cares.

Shirt-Sleeve Jimmy has no interest in . He has no interest in reaching across the aisle, and He’s just a weapon. He’s a blunt instrument. He’s a heat-seeking moron.

I swear, Republicans just keep getting worse. Three years ago, the House GOP rejected Jimmy’s attempt to replace Feckless Kevin McCarthy as Speaker of the House. Back then, they wanted no part of Jordan’s unserious clown act. Now, they’re embracing him with open arms.

And then, as if naming the shouty, half-dressed degenerate wrestling coach to be their Leader weren’t already enough, House Republicans then doubled down on the dumbfuckery, sending Tom Emmer to the podium to make infantile, impotent threats.

“To our colleagues on the left, enjoy this honeymoon phase because, come January 3, 2027, you will regret ever putting your name on a ballot… This Republican leadership team will expose the Democrats’ lies and show the American people their true colors as the radical communists that they are.”

Bro, what the fuck are you gibbering about? That’s now how this works. That’s not how any of this works.

Homie, your party’s in the minority. You hold no power. What ‘lies’ do you imagine you’re going to expose? And what’s all this bullshit about Democrats being ?

You stupid fuck, the midterms were a rejection of all the dumb shit you’ve been pulling, and this is your answer? To promise to dole out more of it?

Do House Republicans have some sort of political death wish? What kind of party watches themselves lose (as of this counting) 43 seats and goes, ‘oh yeah, we’re totally crushing it. Let’s do more of the same.’

Dude, read the room. Voters are sick of idiotic red-baiting, and moronic culture wars. They want someone who’ll fix all the shit you broke. That’s why so many of your former colleagues are now out of jobs. You want to join them? Just keep on doing what you’re doing.

Now let’s move on to asshole, Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand.

Pete weaseled out of getting impeached yesterday, but not before holding some yappy little vanity press conference during which he preened, defiantly flapping his gin-soaked gums in defense of his own lawless self.

“Was die Artikel selbst betrifft: Iran, die Kartelle, Maduro, Jemen. Jede einzelne Operation war rechtmäßig und wurde vom Führer angeordnet.”

In case you don’t speak German, I should probably provide an English translation.

“As for the articles themselves. Iran, the cartels, Maduro, Yemen. Every one was a lawful operation ordered by the Commander-in-Chief.”

Got that? Piss-Drunk Pete was just following orders. Now, where have we all heard that excuse before?

Continuing to write these daily posts has been for me an essential part of my grieving process. But every now and then, the profound sadness of it all becomes just too overwhelming — and so today, I’m going to cut this post short and give myself a bit of a necessary mental health break.

I still feel adrift and unmoored, and I still miss Claudia so much.

Let me once again take a moment to say thank you to the thousands of people who have posted, commented, private messaged, texted, and phoned to offer support and condolences. I am blessed to be surrounded by an amazing, caring community.

Thank you for hanging in there with me. See you tomorrow.

And with that, let’s have us our Daily Claudia.

Today, I want to repost the very first photo I took of Ms Spouse, forty-six-and-a-half years ago, in the spring of 1980, on MacDougal Street in Manhattan.

And I also want to repost Claudia’s final photo, taken on her birthday last February, four days before her passing.

Sigh. I miss her so much.

That’s it for today, I’m outta here. Again, thanks again for hanging in there with me. I promise you that I am taking my own advice: practicing self-care and doing everything I need to do to keep sane. See you tomorrow.

items.title: Whining whiner whines about a stolen election. The entire world tells him to shut the fuck up.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
It’s certainly been a perfectly goddamned delightful week, hasn’t it?

One by one, the worst shitheads in the world lost their elections. Corruption-factory Ken Paxton. Political tourist Darline Graham. Barrel-bottom slimeball Vivek Ramaswamy. All gone , replaced by actual, fundamentally decent people.

Pinch us, we must be dreaming, am I right?

But one thing’s been missing, through this entire week. One familiar noise that’s been conspicuously absent from the national discourse. What could it be?

Does anybody really believe that this “Election” was honest. How could the Polls be so wrong??? Some early voting “dumps” were so large that it was impossible to win, no matter how many people went to vote.It’s all about the machines, which are far more important than the voter! President DJT

Wait a minute. Hold on, what in the actual fuck is this half-baked, weak-tea bullshit?

Donny, you’ve had to work yourself up into a thermonuclear lather, and this is the pathetic mewling you end up farting out? Come on. This is a stolen election, man — it’s right in your wheelhouse. This is the shit you live for.

Couldn’t you have put more effort into this post? Where’s the all-caps hysteria? Where are the multiple exclamation points? This is so low-energy. is that what you want us to call you now? Bro, did you fall asleep in the middle of writing this? Did the Diaper Nurse have to finish it for you, and click ‘send’?

Where are the clownish misspellings? Remember “RIGGED AND STOLLEN” from 2020? Six years later, we’re still pissing ourselves with laughter at that dumbfuckery.

Come on, dude. Give us something to work with here. You didn’t even bother to thank us for our attention.

And why just post? Why not a dozen, each one that much more hysterical than the last? Come on, bro. This is the best you can do? I’m so fucking disappointed in you, Donny. I expected so much better. We all did.

Actually, the best part of Donny’s post was the reaction from the rest of the world, which pretty much rose up as one to tell him to shut the fuck up.

This is getting so old, so fast. You lost. Get over it.

Rep McGovern is right. Donny lost, and he really needs to stick a fucking sock in it.

The first stage of grief is denial, Donald.

Even MAGA’s reaction to Dear Leader’s post was muted. Everyone’s so tired of this shit. MAGA the election wasn’t RIGGED. Nor was it STOLLEN. They themselves voted for James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa and Annie Andrews and Abdul El-Sayed, and on and on.

No one has time for any of Donny’s clownfuckery right now. We all just want it to end. January 3rd can’t come fast enough.

Oh, but Donny wasn’t finished with us, after his whiny ‘stolen election’ post. He had lots more crazy left in the tank. At around four in the afternoon, he summoned the media for a hastily-thrown-together, unscheduled press conference starring none other than The Wrong Dana White™.

The premise of this slapdash dog-and-pony show? That Donny, irrepressible madcap scamp that he is, was just funning with us, when he claimed to have offered the job of White House Press Secretary to the Wrong Dana.

Dana White: “I don’t tell brothers ‘no’ to anything, I know. I didn’t say no. I literally— everybody— every media outlet was calling me, and I didn’t want to be disrespectful and say anything until he— he— he, uh, said something first, so—”

Donny: “We were having a very bad press day. And I said— I don’t know why— I thought of his name. Been my friend for a long time. I said, ‘you know, I think I’m going to get— DANA WHITE to be my new press secretary, sent it to a group of— of— press. And that was it. I sent it to them. And then, they wrote the story as if I wasn’t kidding. And you were INUNDATED and I was inundated. He was here anyway, with— we thought we would have a little fun, and we brought Dana in. He would be— fantastic.”

I have two words. Bull and shit.

Oh please. That’s not what happened at all. I will go to my final resting place convinced that the actual story played out as I wrote it up the other day. Someone in the White House suggested naming the actual trained media spokesperson Dana White be the new Press Sec, and dumb demented Donny got it wrong and mistakenly offered the job to his crony Dana White, the dude who arranges human cockfights for money.

That’s what happened, I’m sure of it. Donny doesn’t make jokes. He has no sense of humor.

Yesterday’s unscheduled presser was a face-saving operation. The Wrong Dana™ had been in London, and they flew him all the way across the ocean so just he could stand at that podium and pretend to have been joking right along with Donny. An actual joke doesn’t need that much explaining attached to it.

The fact that Donny’s handlers put this much time and effort into denying that Donny was making a serious offer is all the proof you need that Donny was in fact making a serious offer.

And look at all the worthless scribblers of the corporate-controlled press, falling for it and laughing. How fucking embarrassing for everyone involved.

But wait — the crazy lasted all the way into the evening.

What the hell? Did you notice that? As Geerges takes the call, a woman is heard giggling in the background, followed by the grating sound of Dear Leader’s voice.

What the fuck was going on? Were Donny and his diaper nurse tickling each other, going, ‘No, YOU call C-SPAN. TEE HEE HEE’?

Where are the adults? What if it hadn’t been C-SPAN? What if Donny and Natty had been daring each other to phone in the nuclear launch codes? Don’t laugh, you know damned well it could happen.

Donny then proceeds to ramble incoherently for eight entire minutes, his putrefying brain pinballing from immigration, to Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand, to Venezuela, to Iran, and back and forth and back and forth. Mimi Geerges keeps trying to interject and steer the conversation, and he just barrels right over her. Eventually, Donny exhausts himself, and Geerges manages to get him off the phone.

It’s fucking batshit. What in god’s name is going on? Donny and Natty should not be left alone, unsupervised. Who knows what they’ll get up to next?

Let’s palate cleanse with some Thomas Massie.

“The Secretary has scheduled his own press conference, that they’re going to let him deliver a rebuttal. And to that point, I hope he addresses the eight articles, and doesn’t get up and misquote the Bible in Quentin Tarantino fashion, and do some pull-ups, and, you know, call everybody fat and gay. I may have just given you half his speech, I don't know.”

Look, let’s be clear-eyed. Thomas Massie is not our friend. He’s against most of the things we’re for. The Heritage Foundation gives him a 96% rating.

Reporter: “Have you spoken to Sen. McConnell about this effort?”

Massie: “I have not, but if it were possible to have a conversation with McConnell...”

Oh man. I only wish Mitch McConnell had been alive to hear himself dissed like that.

And now it’s time for our Daily Claudia.

Here’s a triptych from our living room on December 31, 2021.

Have a great Tuesday, everyone.

items.title: Elderly golfer shits the bed on 60 Minutes
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
What was the point of that?

What were Preznit Fuckwit’s handlers imagining they were going to accomplish, by putting him on 60 Minutes for all the world to see? Was it to remind everyone that Donny is still the Big Boy President? That he wasn’t bent or bowed by the disastrous midterms? That he’s still got what it takes to sit behind the Big Boy Desk in the Oval Bordello, and run the show?

Whatever Donny’s minders were hoping for, it didn’t happen. Dear Leader was so befuddled, and so compromised — both cognitively and ethically — that even a complete lightweight like Ross Fucking Douthat was able to nail him to the wall on corruption.

Ross Douthat: “Here’s what I wanna understand. So your son manages or helps manage a cryptocurrency company called World Liberty Financial. You are a co-owner of that company.”

Donny:

Douthat: “Right? That’s correct, right? This company is also partially owned by investors connected to the government of the United Arab Emirates. I think if I told you that story and it was about the Biden family, if I said Joe Biden is the part owner of a company and it has all of these investments from the Middle East, you would say, ‘That sounds corrupt,’ right—”

Donny dissembles for a bit, trying to explain why his actual corruption is good, while Sleepy Joe Brandon’s imaginary corruption is , but Douthat’s having none of it.

Douthat: “But then why do you need the money? Why not just divest? Walk away—”

Boom, there it is. Donny don’t need this tainted money. He’s already obscenely wealthy, so why doesn’t he just walk away from it, and not even give the

It’s a concept so simple that even Clownstick von Douthat — the Face That Launched A Thousand Dumbfuck Columns — gets it.

But Donny get it, and he launches into another incoherent explanation about why it’s totes cool for him rake in billions off of some dodgy fake-money factory he co-owns with his felonious failsons and also the United Arab Emirates.

Ross once again cuts him off.

Douthat: “But companies that are invested in by people in foreign countries, it seems like you could just walk away from that and then, you know, and then you would not be accused of corruption, right?”

Bro, Ross Douthat is doing you a solid. He’s giving you an out. Just say

But the concept of ‘how about you just don’t be corrupt?’ is so alien to Donny that he has no fucking clue what Douthat is talking about.

But this money goes up to eleven! Why would anyone walk way from it?

Douthat: “There’s a Forbes story that said that your net worth went up by $3 billion since you—”

Donny: “Well, so did everyone’s”

Douthat: “My net worth did not go up by $3 billion.”

Donny: “Well, you should’ve had stock.”

Douthat:

Even Ross is taken aback by Donny’s tone-deaf defense of his own naked greed.

While We the People still struggle to pay for basic goods and services, Dear Leader is out here about how much he’s enriched himself off of taxpayer dollars. Oh, and if your net worth didn’t go up as much as Donny’s did? Well then, it sucks to be you, bro. Maybe you should have done some insider stock trading, like he did. Show some initiative!

Can you imagine if this 60 Minutes interview had aired the Sunday the midterms, and not after? How many additional seats would the Democrats have picked up? Ten? Twelve? All of them?

January 3rd can’t come soon enough. We need a Democratic House and Senate to investigate Donny’s fuckery, and put a stop to as much of it as they can.

Of course, Preznit Fuckwit that accountability is coming for him, and he’s reacting the only way he knows. He’s a penny-ante little mobster, so he immediately starts barking out penny-ante little threats.

Of course, every seedy little mob boss needs a seedy little mob lawyer — and so Donny sent Muggsy Blanche over to CNN’s State of the Union, to do his best to intimidate the incoming Democratic Congress.

Dana Bash: “But I do want to ask you about another thing that that president said. He said that the Democratic lawmakers are extortionists, and they should be imprisoned. Is that a possibility?”

Todd Blanche: [long pause] Well, it depends on what the— the— the crime is and what they’ve done.”

Free clue for Stammerin’ Todd:

isn’t a crime — what it is, is lawmakers doing their Constitutionally-mandated job to root out corruption in the executive branch. It’s what the outgoing Republican Congress should have been doing all along. Todd knows , too.

But Todd’s caught between a rock and an overfull diaper. The Boss wants him to go on the Sunday shows, goddammit, and scare the shit out of the Democrats — and so he has no choice but to show up on CNN and try his best to sound all threatening and stuff, and then sweat and stammer when Dana Bash asks the simple question: It’s all a cheap dog-and-pony show, and Todd knows , too.

January 3rd is coming. Accountability is coming.

Hakeem Jeffries: “I am a hard yes on the Hegseth resolution. The so-called Secretary of Defense has abused his power, undermined our national security, and engineered this reckless and costly war of choice in Iran, which has skyrocketed prices on the American people and made the country less safe. Pete Hegseth has got to go.”

Look, no way am I on Team Jeffries. I do not want him to be Speaker of the House. But it’s nice to hear him be unequivocally on the right side of an issue, for a change.

Well, since we’re down at the bottom of the post, we might as well do some Daily Claudia, right?

Here’s a triptych from down at our lake on September 1, 2018.

Have a great Monday, everyone.

items.title: Senile old shitwit gets his Dana Whites mixed up. Where the fuck is the press?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
You know, I’m so old that I can remember all the way back to , when The New York Times finally published an article confirming what we all already knew: that Dear Leader is bugfuck nuts. It was a well-researched piece, with numerous examples of Donny barking out incoherent nonsense as his pudding-brain visibly leaked out of his ears.

I have a question. Whatever happened to that story? It barely made a ripple in the national zeitgeist. No other news outlet picked it up. Even the Times dropped it after one day.

Shouldn’t a well-documented account of a sitting president whose brain has gone

I am pleased to announce that the Great Dana White, a violent Fighter and Warrior, has been offered the job of Press Secretary of the United States. I have requested that he bring with him assistants, even though some are not from our Country, of Islam Makhachev, Khabib Nurmagomedov, Justin Gaethje, Daniel Cormier, Amanda Nunes, and Kayla Harris. We need these people to defend us against the Lunatic Left. Dana will be a Press Secretary like none other. Dana, please take the job! President DONALD J. TRUMP

What the fuck even is this? Can we not all simply agree to agree that offering the job of White House PressSec to some jamoke who hosts cage matches is just flat out deranged?

Look at that. Article after article, reacting to the putrid mouth-farts of a lunatic as if they were worthy of serious analysis. Donny, for the umpteenth time, shits out something completely insane, and the press dutifully writes it all up, as if Dear Leader were masterfully playing some kind of nth-dimensional chess that we peons are all just too stupid to comprehend.

Which — and I cannot put too fine a point on this — he isn’t. He isn’t playing any kind of chess at all. He’s wandering, lost and confused, with both horsies shoved up his nostrils.

What are we doing here, media? Will nobody point out the obvious, that the emperor has no brain?

A friend whom I will credit when he gives me permission offers the following conjecture about the insane public attempt to hire UFC dude Dana White as WH Press Secretary:

“I think the real story is that someone suggested a woman named Dana White (who has publicist credentials via Fox and Heritage) and Trump misunderstood.”

Her bio is below, also via my friend. I think he may be right.

That’s got to be it, right?

It turns out there are two Dana Whites. One of them is a trained media professional who has already held a press position within the federal government.

The other arranges human cockfights for money.

You just know that someone in the White House said to Donny, ‘hey, why don’t we hire Dana White as PressSec’ — and the stupid fuck’s rotting brain got confused and dredged up the wrong one.

That’s why, when someone said ‘hey, let’s hire Dana White,’ Donny got it wrong.

What fucking insanity is this?

White said Saturday that he plans to meet with Trump on Monday at the White House.

Why? Dana White is not qualified to be Press Secretary. Dana White does not want to Press Secretary. So why is he flying all the way to Washington to waste an afternoon doing some Oval Bordello dog-and-pony show?

Because he wants to do his crony Donny a solid. He’s willing to burn an entire day play-acting so that nobody in the White House has to confess that Dear Leader done fucked up.

And the press is entirely willing to play along.

The universe is just fucking with us right now.

It was all about how, during the run-up to the 2024 election, the press had worked overtime to scrub all the crazy out of Donny’s campaign speeches, helping to hide his cognitive decline from the voters.

It was also about about how, now that Donny had been reelected, the media was trying to sell us on the ridiculous idea that hey, maybe the second term of a fucked-up fascist might actually turn out to be a thing, if we all click our heels together three times and wish really hard.

Here’s one fragment from that post of mine.

the New York Times can fuck all the way off.

what kind of magical, thinking is this?

did Ezra Klein and Ross Douthat both experience some kind of recent head trauma that has caused them to forget the years 2017 through 2020? Donny’s first presidency was a dumpster fire of corruption, mismanagement and mass death — but somehow now, given a second chance to fuck shit up worse, Donny’s going to bring us an “American renewal”?

Two years after I wrote that, the press is still treating Donny — who has grown so much more cognitively collapsed — as if he were kind of some rational actor.

Keep that piece co-written by Ross Douthat in your mind, because if you had been sitting around with a bunch of friends, let’s say fifteen years ago, and someone had asked, as a goof, ‘what’s the worst possible version of 60 Minutes that you could imagine,’ you could have legitimately answered, ‘oh, I don’t know, how about that dumbfuck columnist Ross Douthat interviewing a racist game show host who somehow became president?

In an interview airing Sunday on 60 Minutes, correspondent Ross Douthat asks President Trump: If it took six months of not insulting the Democrats to get a deal done, do you think you could do it?

Oh look — it’s just the worst possible version of a once-respected news program, arranging for the worst possible version of a journalist to interview the worst possible version of a president, asking inane questions that would have been unthinkable, a decade an a half ago.

These are not serious people, yet we’re expected to take them seriously.

We pretty much a Hero of the Day after that, don’t we?

“How does it feel being a loser, Mr. President?”

Yes! That’s how it’s fucking done.

Can we get this guy some kind of Pulitzer?

Hey — it’s time for some Daily Claudia.

Here’s Ms Spouse deciding what to have for lunch at the Windjammer Surf Bar in Westerly, Rhode Island, on September 10, 2024.

I love this place. Look at it, it sits right next to the Atlantic Ocean.

And here’s some random selfie action from June 4, 2022.

Have a great Sunday, everyone.

items.title: This Week In Stupid: November 7 edition
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
As another stupid week comes to a close here in America, let’s look back at the dumbest fucking shit that happened.

Monday: big strong senators with tears in their eyes

“I went to Best Buy this afternoon. I walked in, and three people there were almost in tears, expressing shock, ‘what has happened to our state?”

All righty. Let’s do a quick fact check, because we really need to know: Did this happen? Did big, strong Texans, their cowboy hats slung low over their foreheads in order to hide their tear-stained eyes like few thought possible, actually come up to Ted Cruz and go, ‘Sir! Sir! Please tell us — what has happened to our state? Sir!’

Of course this didn’t fucking happen, and the fact that the whole world is laughing at Ted Cruz and his stupid little story right now is why the entire MAGA movement is going to melt away the moment that Dear Leader goes gently into that good night.

Whose bloated cankles are going to step into Donny’s clown shoes, after he’s gone? Who’s going to say literally the most idiotic shit imaginable, but in a way that makes the cultists swoon? That’s Donny’s one super-power, and no one one else in the MAGAverse has it.

Do you imagine the Esteemed Senator Fidel Cancun is going to pull that off? Oh please, bro has negative charisma. His own daughter cringes.

Tuesday: big strong conspiracy theorists with tears in their eyes

Tuesday was Election Day, and the cultists are still trying to figure it out. ‘How the fuck could this happen to us?’

“I’m just going to say it right now. I have tried to salvage Trump. I’ve invested so much. Maybe I was blind to it. I think he’s the ultimate Democrat sleeper cell, and he works for them. And he was a Democrat before. I’m going to say it right now. He’s not that r*****d. He did this on on purpose. That’s what I believe.”

Sure, why not. It all makes perfect sense to me. The Democrats secretly run a brain-dead stumblefuck for president , so that he can break the entire country — enriching himself in the process — after which Chuck Schumer and Hakeem Jeffries will just waltz in and sweep up whatever’s left over. I can’t believe no one’s ever connected those dots before.

Oh, Alex, you sad little mope. Cope harder, my man. Cope harder.

Wednesday: big strong found objects with tears in their eyes

“There were a lot of people who voted for a dictator. He wanted to be a dictator on Day One, a lot of people said ‘good.’ You know, lock up crooked, deport the whole country. But that didn’t happen. That’s why the base didn’t show up in South Carolina and Mississippi.”

Hey, wait a minute. How did that clip get in there? Because check it out —

What’s going on here? Is Jesse auditioning for a slot on MS-NOW? Or is he so depressed that he forgot to do his ‘look at me, I say stupid shit on television’ court jester act?

My whole world no longer makes sense to me.

Thursday: big strong chucklefucks with tears in their eyes

Okay, I’m going to call it right here and now: Abdul El-Sayed Derangement Syndrome is a thing. Just look at the dude. He’s young. Fit. Good looking. Smart. Charming. Funny. Articulate. You can’t win against all that shit. You can’t even compete against it, and it’s driving the MAGAsphere absolutely fucking insane.

“El-Sayed comes off as a clown. Like one of these guys with an inferiority complex who needs to do this constant puffing all the time. It’s embarrassing.”

Really, Dan? Tell us more. How does El-Sayed come off like a clown? Does he slather his sweaty, putrefying face with a half gallon of burnt cork, and then top it with some cotton-candy rat’s nest of a fright wig?

How does El-Sayed puff himself up? Does he dance as if he were jacking off two invisible giraffes?

Pure projection. At the end of the day, it’s all these shitweasels have left.

Oh, and speaking of an inferior clown who needs to puff himself up, Dan —

Folks, November is Abdul El-Sayed Derangement Syndrome Awareness Month. Won’t you please help find a cure, so that fuckwads like Danny Bingobongo don’t ever again have to karate-chop the air?

Friday: the further adventures of Some Fucking Idiot™

On Friday, some fucking idiot announced that Susie Wiles had been sent to a big farm upstate where she’ll have lots of room to run around, and that undead White House advisor Nosferatu McGoebbels had been promoted to Chief of Staff, because

That’ll teach you not to laugh at the fucking idiot, and call him a loser.

The fucking idiot had one public appearance on his official schedule for Friday: a speech at the Kennedy Space Center in Cape Canaveral, Florida.

Before the thing started, was the fucking idiot presented with some fake gold-plated award that was invented just for the occasion? .

Did the fucking idiot simply shit out his standard campaign speech, even though the election is over? .

Did the fucking idiot repeat his latest whiny, needy talking point? .

Did the fucking idiot mangle common words that any average four-grader could have aced? .

Overall, was the the fucking idiot a sweaty, incoherent mess who told long, pointless stories with no clear beginning, middle or end? ?

By the way, after the speech, the press did actually try to get an answer from the fucking idiot about why his administration was apparently going , sending threatening letters to conservative groups about monitoring their media appearances. The fucking idiot pretended to know nothing about it.

But even though the fucking idiot was right there in front of them, not one reporter stood up to ask, ‘what the fuck is wrong with you?’

How fucking idiotic is that?

And now, let’s put a close to This Week in Stupid and reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia.

Here’s Baby Kate and her mom, in the back yard of our old house in Hastings, early 1990s.

This last one’s from some ocean-side New England inn, on October 19, 2003. There’s Katie, in the mirror.

Have a non-stupid Saturday, everyone.

items.title: Losing loser won’t ever erase the stain of losing the midterms
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Imagine, if you will, that you are United States President Chucklefuck McDingleberry.

Your second term in office has been such a shittacular disaster that your own party has just taken a historic drubbing in the midterms. You’re radioactive right now. The voters have pantsed you. You’ve now been outed as a loser. The rats are leaving your sinking ship. Everyone loathes you. Even your most die-hard cultists are all, History will remember you as a failure. The worst of the worst.

Given all that, what do you do for an encore?

“When you look at that White House, you know, I hear Obama, but he— Obama doesn’t know about dirt and filth. And he doesn’t know about cracked stones. And he doesn’t know about broken windows. He’s probably fine with them. But I’m not. I’m not fine with them.”

Holy fuck, Obama’s tossed-off crack about how Donny’s Oval Bordello ‘looks like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory’ really really got under Donny’s supernaturally-thin skin. He’s still shitting himself raw over it, a week later.

Meet the new Donny, same as the old Donny.

Any competent leader, after being handed such a humiliating loss, would be meeting with staff, and going, ‘how do we fix this? How do we rebuild the trust of the people?’ But not Donny. He is fundamentally incapable of reflection, introspection, or change. He never has been, and he never will be. So he’s going to pretend it never happened. He’s going to blunder right ahead, doing the same old shit, telling the same old lies, boasting about the same old imaginary accomplishments, building the same old useless monuments to himself — and nursing the same old grievances and grudges.

Oh, and Donny has a cunning plan to force everyone to ‘enjoy’ his Oval Bordello in perpetuity.

Donald Trump signed a proclamation on Thursday that he says will prevent future administrations from changing his design of the Oval Office and Cabinet Room, spaces which he declared as national monuments that should be preserved.

See you in court, if you think that’s ever going to happen, fuckface. Every president gets to decorate their own Oval Office. It’s historical precedent.

I have a better idea. Instead of deeming Dear Leader’s vulgar monuments to himself to be worthy of preservation, how about creating a National Registry of Fucking Eyesores To Be Demolished? Because that’s what Donny’s really leaving behind. Fucking eyesores, to be demolished.

  • The Epstein Dance Hall where the East Wing used to be.

  • The Epstein Parking Lot where the Rose Garden used to be.

  • The Epstein Trough of Rancid Water where the Reflecting Pool used to be.

  • The Epstein Helipad where the South Lawn used to be.

And, of course, the Saddam Hussein Cheesecake Experience where the Oval Office used to be.

But it’s not just judge who blocked that shit. It’s a judge we already know and love.

U.S. District Judge Tanya S. Chutkan blocked work on the arch for two weeks while the court considers challenges to its legality. Three Vietnam War veterans, a historic preservationist, the D.C. government and the Commonwealth of Virginia sued to halt construction.

That’s right, it’s She’s the judge who was presiding over Donny’s Big January 6th Insurrection Fuckery Trial, until his reelection put the kibosh on that.

She has no patience for any of Dear Leader’s bullshit, once literally ruling ‘presidents are not kings,’ in a judgement against Donny. It’s heartening to see that she’s still out here, fighting all the good fights, and still getting in Donny’s way.

We thank you for your service.

But it doesn’t matter how man shitty monuments this pathetic dipshit erects in his own fragile, needy honor. He’s never going to erase the stain of being a losing loser who fucked his own party nearly out of existence.

I JUST WASN’T ON THE BALLOT. IF I WERE, WE WOULD HAVE WON IN A LANDSLIDE! President DONALD J. TRUMP

This is now the second time he’s posted this nonsense. Overcompensating much, dumb-ass?

Shut up, loser. You’re a losing loser who loses, and everyone knows it.

Which brings us to our of schadenfreude.

Outgoing Republican Senator Bill Cassidy is very perplexed right now. Apparently, it has just come to the Senator’s attention that an elected official has to — it says here,

“If you look at the shellacking our party took, it’s pretty clear that most voters don’t think that we were there to serve them. They thought, once more, that the politicians wanted to keep power so much that they were willing to change the rules to make the people serve the politicians.”

Wait, was that wrong, to ignore the needs of We the People, opting instead to allow Dear Leader to do whatever the fuck he wanted, and to actually aid and abet him?

I tell ya, Bill Cassidy has to plead ignorance on this thing. Because if anyone had said anything at all to him when he first became a senator that that sort of thing was frowned upon…

Cassidy was the deciding vote on Todd Blanche. He can eat a dick.

Hang on, we should fact-check this. Is that true? Can Senator Cassidy eat a dick?

Yes, he can. Because not only was Cassidy the deciding vote on letting the Donny’s personal ambulance-chaser become Attorney General — he was also the deciding vote on Bobby Brainworms being put in charge of our nation’s healthcare.

Sorry, but the Esteemed Senator doesn’t get to go on cable news and point his finger at everyone else. His hands are as dirty as the rest of his party’s.

Bill Cassidy can go pound salt.

Remember how bleak and hopeless things seemed, that morning?

bleak and hopeless, for a good long while. It

Here’s what I wrote in that post from November 6, 2024.

America is about to go through some things. This hurts a lot, I know. Remember, we still have each other. We’re all in this together.

Let the events of the past week be a reminder that situations can and do change for the better, when we all work together. We will always be here for each other. We will always be in this together.

Which brings me to . Someone’s come up with an all-new reason for canceling their paid subscription. It’s because I’m obsolete!

Okay, that made me laugh out loud. I can’t even get disgruntled by it. Seriously, if anyone feels they no longer need a daily dose of this shit,

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

Here’s Ms Spouse, so bemused by something she saw going on in the background in Half Moon on March 8, 2024, that she took out her phone and captured it.

Have a great Friday, everyone.

items.title: All we want are Democrats who’ll fight the fascists. Is that too much to ask?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
‘You’re not a wartime Consigliere.’

That’s Michael Corleone’s famous line from The Godfather, in which he explains to Corleone family counselor Tom Hagen that shit’s about to get real, and you don’t have what it takes.

Know who else isn’t a ? Hakeem Fucking Jeffries, the Man Who Would Be Speaker of the House. Jeffries couldn’t his way out of a paper bag. I’m not even sure he understands what the actual job entails.

Morning Joe: “Donald Trump said ‘I am your retribution,’ and he got wiped out. How do you now say, ‘hey, let’s not look behind us. We’re going to focus on bringing costs down’?”

Hakeem Jeffries: “The American people don’t want us to get even, they want us to get things done on their behalf.”

Holy shit, that sounds like a carefully-rehearsed line, doesn’t it? Why?

I’ve never understood this pathological compulsion of Democratic leadership to go out the morning after every election and immediately piss all over everyone’s corn flakes. Is it too much to ask, to let us savor a victory for one whole day, before you start shitting all over everything?

Why this need to assure us that there won’t be any ? No one’s asking for ‘retribution.’ What we want is . We’ve just lived through two years of the greatest lawlessness and corruption from a federal government that this country has ever experienced — big strong corruption with tears in its eyes — and now it’s time for some accountability. That’s not

Preznit Fuckwit spent two years treating the US Treasury as his personal cash machine, fattening his wallet at our expense. We the People are struggling to make ends meet, while Dear Leader is somehow now a billionaire. Calling him to account for that is not

Holding Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand accountable for clownfucking us into an unwinnable war that destroyed our military readiness and set the world’s economy teetering on the edge of a crash, that’s not

Holding everyone at Homeland Security accountable for masked ICE thugs disappearing innocent people into Salvadoran slave labor gulags, or leaving them shot to death on the street, that’s not

It’s getting fucking justice, and it’s high time we had a little around here.

How did Hakeem Jeffries allow himself to get manipulated by that useless pantload Morning Joe into disavowing ?

Could it be because he’s ?

You know who else isn’t a ? Chuck Fucking Schumer. He’s been proving it every day through his impotent lack of action. Schumer’s a great guy to have around if there’s absolutely nothing at stake.Need someone to speak at the dedication of a new post office? Chuck’s your man. Need someone to make sure all the procedural i’s are dotted and t’s are crossed in some piece of shrimp boat legislation? Here comes Chuck!

Do you need someone to fight fascism? Chuck’s your— wait, where the fuck did Chuck go? He was here a minute ago.

He’s probably busy writing a strongly-worded letter.

Fortunately, we do have Democrats who aren’t so tone deaf, and do know how to say — and do — the right things.

In case you somehow missed it in yesterday’s post, let me just leave this right here.

That’s Rep. Robert Garcia, the Democrat who is now the incoming chairman of the House Oversight Committee. He posted that Tuesday night, after winning his own reelection.

Know who Rep. Garcia replaces as Oversight Chair? This rake-stepping fuckwit, Comer Fudd.

Is that an upgrade, or what? Imagine going from clownish side-show hearings involving Hunter Biden’s freakishly-oversized trouser trout, to actual investigations into how companies that Donny’s felonious failsons are invested in ended up getting billions of dollars in government defense contracts. You want to talk about an actual crime family? Boy, have I ever got one for you.

Here’s what Rep. Stansbury has to say about her video.

ARE YOU ALL READY FOR THIS???! 💙🔥 Because we are JUST GETTING STARTED!

Do you know who else are ready to fight the current Republican regime?

Many Republican lawmakers and allies alarmed by Tuesday’s wipeout are moving swiftly to pin blame for the election results on Hegseth, arguing behind the scenes that he played a chief role in convincing Trump to attack Iran with no exit strategy — and no plan for managing the inevitable political fallout.

They’re not wrong about how we got bogged down in the Middle East. Piss-Drunk Pete absolutely snookered his demented boss, and filled his ears with fairy-tale nonsense about how he could bomb the shit out of Iran and be won and done in a couple of hours, with plenty of time left over for Pete to get soused down at the local bar.

‘Drinnnkssss are on me, I just whupped Iran’s assssssss.’

How did that work out for you, Pete? How did that work out for any of us?'

Sucks to be you right now, Pete. They’re shoving you into a peach.

House Republicans are expected to vote to directly repudiate the defense secretary in a matter of days. Rep. Thomas Massie of Kentucky, the famously anti-Trump GOP lawmaker, told CNN he plans to trigger a vote to impeach Hegseth when Congress returns next week — and multiple GOP sources said they expect it to pass.

Leave it to Republicans to show us how it’s done. They’re not even waiting until the next Congress to stick their knives into their targets. They’re doing it

Maybe Hakeem Jeffries might wan to take lessons from Thomas Massie.

And now we must interrupt this post for an important message from Daughter Katie.

I’m sure you love taking requests, so: you should use your platform to encourage people to call their new representatives and yell at them to demand they not put Jeffries and Schumer back in charge.

Folks, Ms Spouse and I raised our daughter right, didn’t we? In fact, Katie is absolutely correct. We should all be calling our Reps and Senators (or their replacements) right now, and demanding leadership that will work to please , and not Morning Joe.

All those phone numbers and shit can be found at the House and Senate web sites.

Key Senate progressive Chris Van Hollen said Wednesday that Democrats should demand a “bold agenda” targeting entrenched corporate interests in Washington before agreeing to back Chuck Schumer or any other aspiring Senate majority leader.

It’s our job to push — — them across the finish line.

“Somebody came in, in the break there, and brought me a quote that we got from the president from the White House tonight, in response to the results, and I just threw it away. HA HA HA HA HA! That felt good, too. Guess what? It doesn’t matter. What do you think? Who has to care?”

Ah, that glorious moment when you realize that Dear Leader

We’re all about ready for some Daily Claudia now, right?

Since Katie’s already made an appearance in this post, let’s continue the theme. Here she is with her mom in Newport, Rhode Island, early 1990s.

This one’s at home, in the early 1990s.

And, lastly, Katie in front of her house, with her mom, on June 20, 2018.

Have a great Thursday, everyone.
